description: This file implements a GStreamer plugin element for Rialto Web Audio sink, handling state changes, events, and communication with Rialto server components for web audio playback.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSink
classes.description: A GStreamer element class implementing a Rialto Web Audio sink, managing state transitions, event handling, and communication with web audio client.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_eos_handler
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream event, posting EOS or error message based on current state.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_error_handler
methods.description: Posts an error message to the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_rialto_state_changed_handler
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the Rialto server, managing asynchronous state transitions.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_setup_supported_caps
methods.description: Sets up supported caps for the sink element.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_send_event
methods.description: Handles events sent to the sink pad, such as EOS and CAPS.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_change_state
methods.description: Manages state transitions of the GStreamer element, coordinating with the web audio client.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_event
methods.description: Processes events on the sink pad, such as opening web audio with caps or EOS.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_get_property
methods.description: Handles property get requests; ts-offset property is not supported.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_set_property
methods.description: Handles property set requests; ts-offset property is not supported.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_chain
methods.description: Pushes new samples to the web audio client.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_initialise_sinkpad
methods.description: Initializes the sink pad with event and chain functions.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoWebAudioSink object, setting up client callbacks and sink pad.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization, setting up metadata, properties, and function pointers.
